button.summary: Action control for text, icons or both. Variants set emphasis, and it handles sizes, a loading state and rendering as a link.
button.useFor: Button covers click-to-act controls, from a primary form submit to a quiet row action or an avatar menu trigger. Variants set emphasis. Profiles handle special placements such as an icon action inside a field or a link in running text.

neighbours.name: toggle
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toggle when the control holds an on/off pressed state. Button fires a one-time action.

neighbours.name: copy-button
neighbours.guidance: Pick Copy Button when the action writes a value to the clipboard. It handles the confirmation, the failure case and the screen reader announcement for you.

neighbours.name: toolbar
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toolbar when a row of related actions should share one tab stop and move with arrow keys.

neighbours.name: group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Group to join several buttons, or a button and an input, into one segmented frame.

rules: Reserve `variant="accent"` for the one main action on a surface. Use `default`, `outline` or `ghost` for the rest.
To navigate, use `render={<a href=... />}` or a router link that forwards props and ref. `variant="link"` on its own changes the look and nothing else.
Inside a form, set `type="submit"` yourself. A plain Button defaults to `type="button"`.
Name icon-only controls: use `IconButton` with `label`, or put `aria-label` on a square Button.
`loading` (or `LoadingButton` with an async `action`) blocks repeat clicks during a request. Choose `aria-disabled` over `disabled` when the control must stay reachable by Tab.
Give icon buttons inside an InputGroup (show/hide, clear, open picker) `profile="field-action"` and `shape="square"` instead of hand-styling a ghost button.

copy-button.summary: Copies a value to the clipboard and confirms success or failure on screen and to screen readers.
copy-button.useFor: Put Copy Button next to values people paste elsewhere, like invite links, API IDs, addresses and short tokens. It can be a bare icon after the value, a labelled text button, or an icon action inside an input group.

neighbours.name: button
neighbours.guidance: Pick Button when the action does something besides copying. Copy Button owns the copied and failed states.

neighbours.name: input-group
neighbours.guidance: Pair with Input Group when the value sits in a read-only field and the copy icon belongs at its end.

neighbours.name: code
neighbours.guidance: For a code block, pick Code with `copyable`. It places this button inside the block for you.

rules: Name the icon-only form after what it copies, through `labels.copy` or `aria-label`. Example: "Copy invite link".
Show the value next to the button so people can select it by hand if the clipboard write fails.
Pass a function to `value` to fetch the text on press. Keep that request short: browsers allow a copy only for a brief window after the gesture.
In `onCopyError`, tell people what to do next when copying is unavailable, such as on plain http.
In a field, set `profile="field-action"`. In a menu, keep a `MenuItem` and call `useCopyToClipboard` from its handler.

toggle.summary: One button that stays pressed or unpressed, for on/off tool states like bold or bookmark.
toggle.useFor: Toggle is a standalone pressed-state control for editors, toolbars and cards, where the button shows whether something is on. It fits formatting tools, favourites and view options that take effect on press.

neighbours.name: switch
neighbours.guidance: Pick Switch for a saved on/off setting, above all one that submits with a form.

neighbours.name: checkbox
neighbours.guidance: Pick Checkbox when the choice is a form value or an agreement. Toggle holds a tool state.

neighbours.name: toggle-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toggle Group when several related toggles belong together, as one-of-many or any-of-many.

rules: Leave the label and icon fixed when the state flips. Assistive tech already reports whether it is pressed.
An icon-only toggle needs `padding="icon"` to stay square and a fixed `aria-label`.
Control the state with `pressed` and `onPressedChange` when the app already knows it, such as the current text formatting.
Toggle submits no form value. Serialize the state yourself, or use Checkbox or Switch.
Save `lift` for reactions like a like or favourite. Ordinary tool toggles go without it.

toggle-group.summary: Related pressed-state buttons that share one selection, single or multiple, with arrow-key movement.
toggle-group.useFor: Toggle Group fits compact option sets that act on press, such as text alignment, list or grid view, and formatting marks. It handles single or multiple pressed items and arrow-key navigation across the set.

neighbours.name: radio-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Radio Group when one answer is a required form value. Toggle Group lets people clear a single selection.

neighbours.name: tabs
neighbours.guidance: Pick Tabs when each option swaps a content panel. Toggle Group changes a view setting.

neighbours.name: toolbar
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toolbar when the row mixes plain buttons, selects and toggles. A Toggle Group can sit inside it.

neighbours.name: toggle
neighbours.guidance: Use a lone Toggle for a single on/off option.

rules: Treat `value` as an array in both single and `multiple` mode.
To keep one option selected at all times, ignore empty arrays in `onValueChange`.
Name each toggle group: point `aria-labelledby` at a visible `FieldLabel`, or fall back to `aria-label`.
Set `size` and `variant` on the group so the `ToggleGroupItem`s match. Split sets with `ToggleGroupSeparator`.
Set `orientation="vertical"` for stacked items so arrow keys follow the layout.

toolbar.summary: A labelled row of related controls that takes one tab stop and moves between items with arrow keys.
toolbar.useFor: Toolbar holds editor formatting bars, canvas tools and table action rows full of small controls. Roving focus gives the set one tab stop, so keyboard users skip past it with a single Tab.

neighbours.name: group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Group when the controls only need a joined look and each keeps its own tab stop.

neighbours.name: toggle-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toggle Group for a set that shares a pressed selection; nest it inside a Toolbar when the bar also has other actions.

neighbours.name: menu
neighbours.guidance: Move infrequent actions into a Menu opened from the toolbar so the row stays short.

rules: Give the toolbar, and any meaningful `ToolbarGroup`, an accessible label.
Build items from `ToolbarButton`, `ToolbarLink`, `ToolbarInput` and `ToolbarGroup` so they join the arrow-key focus order.
Set `size` once on `Toolbar`; a group or item can override it for its own controls.
Divide clusters with `ToolbarSeparator` instead of spacing alone.
Set `focusableWhenDisabled` on a `ToolbarButton` that must stay reachable while unavailable.

input.summary: A single-line text control with surface variants and sizes; it also ships Field for labels, help and errors.
input.useFor: Input takes short free text such as names, emails, URLs, passwords and search terms, plus native types like file. Wrap it in a Field to wire the label, description and validation message to the control.

neighbours.name: textarea
neighbours.guidance: Pick Textarea when the answer can run past one line.

neighbours.name: number-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Number Field for numbers that need stepping, bounds or locale formatting.

neighbours.name: input-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Input Group when the input needs an attached prefix, icon or action button.

neighbours.name: autocomplete
neighbours.guidance: Pick Autocomplete when suggestions should help people type free text.

rules: Give it a visible label through Field and FieldLabel. A placeholder does not name the control.
Set `invalid` on the surrounding Field and explain the problem with FieldError instead of coloring the input red.
Use `readOnly` for values people can see and submit but not change. Use `disabled` only when the value should not submit.
Read the text through `onValueChange`. A form reset leaves a controlled Input untouched, so clear your own state inside `onReset`.
Use `insetStart`/`insetEnd` for adjoining elements. Put a password reveal in an InputGroup instead of inside the Input.

textarea.summary: A multiline text control that grows with its content between a minimum and maximum number of lines.
textarea.useFor: Textarea takes descriptions, comments, bios and messages that may wrap or run to paragraphs. It sizes itself to the text, so you set limits in lines instead of a fixed height.

neighbours.name: input
neighbours.guidance: Pick Input when the answer fits on one line.

neighbours.name: input-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Input Group with InputGroupTextarea when the box needs a header, footer or corner action like a send button.

neighbours.name: prompt-input
neighbours.guidance: Pick Prompt Input for a chat or AI composer with attachments and submit behavior built in.

rules: Set height with `minLines` and `maxLines`; native `rows` does not control it.
Listen with native `onChange`; Textarea has no `onValueChange`.
Enforce limits with `maxLength` and show the remaining count from a controlled `value`.
Label it through Field and FieldLabel, and put errors on the Field with FieldError.
Use `readOnly` for submitted but locked text and `disabled` only when it should not submit.

number-field.summary: A numeric input with step buttons, bounds, locale formatting and optional drag-to-scrub.
number-field.useFor: Number Field holds numbers people adjust: quantities, seats, timeouts, budgets. It keeps the value numeric while showing it formatted, and clamps it to your range.

neighbours.name: slider
neighbours.guidance: Pick Slider when an approximate position on a range matters more than an exact number.

neighbours.name: input
neighbours.guidance: Pick Input for digit strings that are not quantities, like phone numbers or postcodes.

neighbours.name: otp-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick OTP Field for a fixed-length verification code.

rules: Compose `NumberFieldGroup` with `NumberFieldDecrement`, `NumberFieldInput` and `NumberFieldIncrement`, and add `NumberFieldScrubArea` with a `label` for scrubbing.
Use `null` for an empty value, and constrain edits with `min`, `max` and `step`.
Pass `format` and `locale` for currency or percent; the stored value stays a plain number.
Put the `name` on the surrounding Field so Form submits the number, and add `className="w-full"` when it should fill a column.
Keep the label above the control. Number Field has no floating label.

otp-field.summary: One-time-code entry with a slot per character, separate or joined. It handles paste and auto-advance.
otp-field.useFor: OTP Field takes verification, two-factor and recovery codes of a known length. It manages typing, pasting and deletion across slots, and can submit the form once the code is complete.

neighbours.name: input
neighbours.guidance: Pick Input when the code length varies or the value is a password.

neighbours.name: number-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Number Field when the digits form a quantity instead of a code.

rules: Set `length` and render exactly that many `OTPFieldInput` slots; `OTPFieldSeparator` does not count.
Label the field once. The first slot takes the Field label, so name only the slots after it.
Use `validationType="alphanumeric"` for recovery codes and `layout="joined"` for a single-input look.
Treat `onValueComplete` or `autoSubmit` as a trigger only, and verify the code with rate limits on the server.
Keep the label on top. OTP Field takes no floating label.

label.summary: A plain visible label for a native control, plus a card variant for checkbox, radio and switch options.
label.useFor: Label names a control outside a Field, or wraps a checkbox, radio or switch with its sentence so the text is clickable. The card variant turns each option into a bordered, selectable tile.

neighbours.name: field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Field with FieldLabel when you also need help text, a required marker or validation wired to the control.

neighbours.name: fieldset
neighbours.guidance: Pick Fieldset to name a group of controls with a legend.

rules: Connect it with `htmlFor` to the control's id, or wrap the control inside it.
Use `variant="card"` for choice cards and let Label own the border, hover, checked and disabled styles.
Keep secondary buttons outside a card Label so clicking them does not toggle the option.
Label is no stand-in for FieldLabel. It adds no required marker, help or validation.
Keep the native element. If you swap it via `render`, restore native label behavior yourself.

field.summary: Ties a control to its label, help text and validation messages, with top or floating labels.
field.useFor: Wrap Field around each form control that has a label, description or error. It owns validation timing, the required marker and the accessible links between parts, and offers floating labels for compact forms.

neighbours.name: label
neighbours.guidance: Pick plain Label for a control that needs a name and nothing else.

neighbours.name: fieldset
neighbours.guidance: Pick Fieldset to group several Fields under one legend, or render a Field as a Fieldset for checkbox and radio groups.

neighbours.name: form
neighbours.guidance: Pick Form as the outer boundary that submits Fields, sets form-wide validation mode and maps server errors.

rules: Keep `FieldLabel`, the control, `FieldDescription` and `FieldError` inside one `Field`. Field links them for you.
Put `required` on the control and add `requiredIndicator` to the Field instead of typing an asterisk into the label.
Run client-side checks through `validate` and `validationMode`. When your app decides the error itself, mark Field as `invalid` and give FieldError `match`.
Use `labelPlacement="floating"` only with Input, Textarea, Select and single-select Combobox or Autocomplete. Leave it off any control with a leading icon.
Change spacing with the `--field-gap` variable, not a `gap-*` utility, so FieldError stays aligned.
Install it with `input`; Field has no registry item of its own.

fieldset.summary: Groups related form fields under a shared legend and optional description, and can disable them together.
fieldset.useFor: Fieldset puts clusters like a shipping address, billing details or a set of radio options under one shared name. Disabling the Fieldset disables every control in it.

neighbours.name: field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Field for a single control; render a Field as the Fieldset when a radio or checkbox group needs a legend and one name.

neighbours.name: card
neighbours.guidance: Pick Card for a visual container. Put a Fieldset inside it when the controls also need a shared accessible name.

neighbours.name: form
neighbours.guidance: Pick Form for submission and validation. Fieldset groups controls and does not submit.

rules: Write a `FieldsetLegend` that says what the controls have in common.
Put shared help for the group in `FieldsetDescription` and help for one input in FieldDescription.
Set `disabled` on Fieldset to switch off every control inside it. Keep it away from read-only displays.
For radio or checkbox groups, render the Field as the Fieldset. The legend then labels the whole set, and each option inherits the Field's name.

form.summary: The submit boundary for Fields: form-wide validation timing, server error mapping and reset handling.
form.useFor: Wrap Form around Fields that submit together, from a sign-in to a settings page. It decides when validation runs, shows server errors next to the right field, and moves focus to the first problem.

neighbours.name: field
neighbours.guidance: Use Field for each control inside the Form. Field-level settings override the Form's.

neighbours.name: fieldset
neighbours.guidance: Pick Fieldset to group related Fields within the Form under a legend.

rules: Pass server messages through `errors`, keyed by each Field's `name`.
Use `onFormSubmit` to receive values without a page navigation, or call `preventDefault` yourself in `onSubmit`.
Give the submit Button `type="submit"` and show `loading` on it while your request runs.
Restore controlled values in `onReset`. A native reset leaves React state alone.
Re-validate on the server; async `Field.validate` does not block submission.

checkbox.summary: A box for one independent yes/no choice, with indeterminate state and form submission built in.
checkbox.useFor: Checkbox covers agreements, opt-ins and single options that are checked or not and submit with a form. It is also the option inside a Checkbox Group.

neighbours.name: switch
neighbours.guidance: Pick Switch for a setting that takes effect on change, like enabling notifications.

neighbours.name: checkbox-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Checkbox Group when several related options share one name and selection.

neighbours.name: radio-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Radio Group when exactly one option of a set must be chosen.

neighbours.name: toggle
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toggle for a pressed tool state in a toolbar. Checkbox holds a form value.

rules: Wrap the box and its text in `FieldLabel` or `Label` so clicking the text toggles it.
Use `checked` with `onCheckedChange` only when the app owns the value. Otherwise use `defaultChecked`.
Set `uncheckedValue` when the server needs a value for the unchecked state. Without it, an unchecked box sends nothing.
`aria-invalid` only styles the box. Field and FieldError carry the error itself.
Use `Label variant="card"` for card-style options instead of rebuilding checked styles.

checkbox-group.summary: Holds a set of related checkboxes as one array value, with an optional parent box that selects all.
checkbox-group.useFor: Checkbox Group lets people pick any number of related options, such as notification channels, permissions or visible columns. It shares size and selection across the boxes and can show a mixed parent state.

neighbours.name: radio-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Radio Group when people may choose only one option.

neighbours.name: combobox
neighbours.guidance: Pick Combobox with `multiple` when the list is long enough to need search.

neighbours.name: toggle-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toggle Group with `multiple` for compact tool options that act on press and do not submit.

rules: Give each Checkbox a unique `value`. Control selection with `value` and `onValueChange` when needed.
For select-all, mark one Checkbox as `parent` and list each child's value in `allValues`.
Render the Field as a Fieldset with a legend. That names the group and applies the Field `name` to each box.
For a horizontal layout, use `className="flex-row gap-4"`. Your gap utility replaces the default 8 px vertical gap.

radio-group.summary: A set of visible options where exactly one is chosen, with arrow-key movement and form submission.
radio-group.useFor: Radio Group fits short, mutually exclusive choices people compare at a glance: plans, frequencies, delivery speeds. Options can carry descriptions or appear as selectable cards.

neighbours.name: select
neighbours.guidance: Pick Select when there are many options, or space is tight and side-by-side comparison matters less.

neighbours.name: checkbox-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Checkbox Group when several options can be on at once.

neighbours.name: toggle-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toggle Group for a compact view or tool switch that acts on press.

neighbours.name: list-box
neighbours.guidance: Pick List Box for a single choice from a longer visible list of rich rows.

rules: Give each `Radio` a unique `value`. Control the choice with `value` and `onValueChange` when needed.
Render the Field as a Fieldset with a legend. The group then has a name and submits under the Field `name`.
For options with descriptions, put each Radio in a `FieldItem` beside a `FieldLabel` and `FieldDescription`.
Use `Label variant="card"` for plan-style cards so the whole card selects the option.
Set `size` once on the group; a Radio's own size overrides it.

switch.summary: An on/off control for a setting, with an optional label and description row and form submission.
switch.useFor: Switch fits on/off preferences and feature flags, the kind found on settings pages. People read it as a setting to change, and it fits a row with a label and description beside it.

neighbours.name: checkbox
neighbours.guidance: Pick Checkbox for consent, agreements or options that only matter on submit.

neighbours.name: toggle
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toggle for a pressed tool button in an editor or toolbar.

neighbours.name: settings-list
neighbours.guidance: Pick Settings List for a full page of setting rows, each holding a Switch or another control.

rules: Inside a Field, place `FieldLabel` and `FieldDescription` before the Switch so both describe it.
Use `checked` and `onCheckedChange` when the app saves the setting on change. Otherwise use `defaultChecked`.
Set `uncheckedValue` if the form must send a value while it is off.
Switch has no indeterminate mode, so keep it away from mixed or partial states.
For card rows, use `Label variant="card"` instead of restyling the switch.

slider.summary: Pick a number or a range by dragging thumbs along a track, with optional scale labels.
slider.useFor: Slider suits values where relative position matters more than precision: volume, price ranges, storage limits, timeouts. Pass an array for a range and you get one thumb per value.

neighbours.name: number-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Number Field when people need to type an exact value.

neighbours.name: meter
neighbours.guidance: Pick Meter to show a value people cannot change.

neighbours.name: progress
neighbours.guidance: Pick Progress to show how far a task has got.

rules: Name the slider with a Field label or `aria-label`. Scale `labels` do not count as a name.
For a range, pass an array to `value` or `defaultValue`. Set `min` and `max` yourself instead of relying on defaults.
Use `onValueCommitted` for expensive work and `onValueChange` for live display.
Show the current number with `SliderValue` when the exact value matters.
To include the slider in form data, set `name` on its Field. A range slider posts one entry per thumb.

select.summary: A trigger that opens a fixed list of options for one or several choices, without typing to filter.
select.useFor: Select picks from a known, moderate list such as a region, role or team, where search adds nothing. It supports groups, icons, multiple selection and a ghost trigger for values inside rows.

neighbours.name: combobox
neighbours.guidance: Pick Combobox when the list is long enough that people need to type to find an option.

neighbours.name: autocomplete
neighbours.guidance: Pick Autocomplete when the answer can be any text and the options are suggestions.

neighbours.name: radio-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Radio Group for a few options people should see side by side.

neighbours.name: menu
neighbours.guidance: Pick Menu when the list holds actions instead of a value.

rules: Pass `items` to Select so the trigger shows a stored ID's label before the popup opens.
Set `size` and `variant` on `SelectTrigger`, not on the root.
Use `SelectGroup`, `SelectGroupLabel` and `SelectSeparator` for sections, and `SelectLabel` or FieldLabel to name the control.
Use `itemToStringValue` for object items so the form submits the right string.
Set `name` and `required` and place it in a Field. Form then blocks an empty submit and FieldError explains why.
Don't use the placeholder as the label.

combobox.summary: A searchable picker that filters known options as you type, single or multi-select with chips.
combobox.useFor: Combobox picks from a fixed list too long to browse, like assignees, countries, time zones or labels. Typing narrows the list, options can sit in groups, and multiple picks show as removable chips.

neighbours.name: select
neighbours.guidance: Pick Select for a short list where typing adds nothing.

neighbours.name: autocomplete
neighbours.guidance: Pick Autocomplete when the typed text is the value and suggestions are optional.

neighbours.name: command
neighbours.guidance: Pick Command for a searchable list of actions or navigation. Combobox holds a form value.

neighbours.name: checkbox-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Checkbox Group when a handful of multi-select options can all stay visible.

rules: Set `size` and `variant` on `ComboboxInput`, and turn on `showClear` when clearing is common.
For multi-select, set `multiple` and render `ComboboxChip`s inside `ComboboxChips` through `ComboboxValue`. The chips already have a remove button.
When items are objects, provide `itemToStringLabel` for display and filtering and `itemToStringValue` for submission.
Render a `ComboboxEmpty` so a query with no matches explains itself, and handle async loading through `ComboboxStatus`.
For a select-looking trigger with search, use `ComboboxTrigger render={<SelectButton />}` with an embedded `ComboboxInput` in the popup.
Use `indicatorPosition="end"` on items that lead with an avatar or logo.

autocomplete.summary: A text input that suggests completions while still accepting whatever the person types.
autocomplete.useFor: Autocomplete fits answers people type themselves with help from suggestions: job titles, tags, search queries, city names. The form submits whatever they type, even when no suggestion matches.

neighbours.name: combobox
neighbours.guidance: Pick Combobox when only values from the list are allowed.

neighbours.name: input
neighbours.guidance: Pick plain Input when you have no useful suggestions.

neighbours.name: select
neighbours.guidance: Pick Select for a short fixed list that rejects free text.

rules: Treat `value` as a plain string holding arbitrary text. It does not point to a selected item.
Use `itemToStringValue` for object items so selecting one fills the input with the right text.
Cap long lists with `limit` and report the remainder through `AutocompleteStatus` using `useAutocompleteFilter`.
Render `AutocompleteEmpty` for no matches. Your app code owns async fetching and errors.
Set `size` and `variant` on `AutocompleteInput`, and place it in a Field with a `name` to submit.

list-box.summary: An always-visible list where one row is selected, with rich multiline rows and typeahead.
list-box.useFor: List Box holds a single choice from a short to medium list that stays on screen, such as a workspace or template with descriptions. It fits side panels and pickers inside dialogs.

neighbours.name: select
neighbours.guidance: Pick Select when the options should hide in a popup until needed.

neighbours.name: radio-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Radio Group for a plain form question that must submit natively.

neighbours.name: combobox
neighbours.guidance: Pick Combobox when the list needs text search.

neighbours.name: menu
neighbours.guidance: Pick Menu when the rows trigger actions and hold no selection.

rules: Give each `ListBoxItem` a stable string `value` and control selection with `value` and `onValueChange`.
Name the list with a visible `FieldLabel` referenced by `aria-labelledby`, or an `aria-label`.
Set `textValue` on rich items so typeahead matches the title only.
Serialize the selection yourself. List Box submits no native form value and has no multiple mode.
Use `selectionAppearance="row"` when the check mark adds noise to rich rows.

input-group.summary: One input surface with text, icons, buttons or a header and footer attached around an input or textarea.
input-group.useFor: Input Group attaches extras to a field: a currency or protocol prefix, a search icon, a show-password action, an apply button, or a toolbar under a comment box. It draws one frame around everything.

neighbours.name: group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Group to join separate controls, like an input and a submit button, as segments with their own frames.

neighbours.name: input
neighbours.guidance: Pick plain Input when nothing attaches to the field.

neighbours.name: prompt-input
neighbours.guidance: Pick Prompt Input for a full chat composer.

rules: Put `InputGroupInput` or `InputGroupTextarea` inside the group. The group owns the surface and the inner control stays unstyled.
Place extras in `InputGroupAddon` with `align` set to inline-start, inline-end, block-start or block-end.
For icon actions, use Button with `profile="field-action"` and `shape="square"`. Keep a password toggle's label constant and show its state with `aria-pressed`.
Addon text is not part of the value or the label. Name the field with Field and FieldLabel.
Compose Button directly. Input Group has no InputGroupButton part.

group.summary: Joins related buttons, or an input and its button, into one segmented frame. The controls share no state.
group.useFor: Group builds split buttons, segmented action sets, zoom controls, or a search input joined to its submit button. Each control keeps its own behavior and tab stop.

neighbours.name: toolbar
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toolbar when the controls should share one tab stop with arrow-key navigation.

neighbours.name: toggle-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Toggle Group when the segments share a pressed selection.

neighbours.name: input-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Input Group when the addon belongs inside one input surface.

rules: Name each Group with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.
Use `GroupText` for a fixed prefix or unit and give the input its own accessible name.
Wrap an input-plus-button Group in a Form, with `type="submit"` on the button, so pressing Enter sends it.
Give icon-only segments `shape="square"` instead of a fixed icon size so heights match.
Use `GroupSeparator` between non-button controls, or `separator="inset"` for button rows.

calendar.summary: An inline month grid for picking a single date, several dates or a range, with unavailable-day rules.
calendar.useFor: Calendar keeps the date grid on the page, for a booking flow, a scheduling sidebar or a range picker with shortcuts. It shares one options object with the kit's date pickers.

neighbours.name: date-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Picker when the calendar should open from a compact button.

neighbours.name: date-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Field when typing is the main path, as with a birth date.

neighbours.name: date-range-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Range Picker for a compact typed range field with a popover calendar.

rules: Choose `selectionMode` (single, multiple or range) first; it sets the shape of `value`.
Block days with `disabled` matchers and limit navigation with `startMonth` and `endMonth`.
Define shared `CalendarOptions` once and reuse them in Calendar and in each picker's `calendarProps`.
Control `month` alongside `value` when your own buttons, like Today, change the date.
Values are local-midnight Date objects, so choose a storage format on purpose, for example `YYYY-MM-DD`.
Give it an `aria-label`; do not pass React Aria `CalendarDate` or `minValue` props.

date-field.summary: A typed date input built from day, month and year segments, with an optional calendar popover.
date-field.useFor: Date Field lets people who know the date type it fast, as with invoice dates or birth dates, and still offers a calendar. It submits a stable ISO day string whatever the display locale.

neighbours.name: date-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Picker when choosing from a calendar is the main path and typing adds nothing.

neighbours.name: date-time-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Time Picker when a time of day is needed too.

neighbours.name: calendar
neighbours.guidance: Pick Calendar when the month grid should stay visible on the page.

rules: Store `null` for an empty controlled value; `onValueChange` reports `undefined` when cleared.
Pass `calendarProps` with `disabled`, `startMonth` and `endMonth`. Typed dates that break those rules turn invalid.
Set `name` to submit `YYYY-MM-DD`, and use `required` with FieldError for the missing message.
Use `iconMode="decorative-start"` for birth dates, where a calendar does not help.
Name it with FieldLabel or `aria-label`, keep a top label, and add `className="w-full"` to fill a column.

date-picker.summary: A button that opens a calendar to choose one date, showing the chosen date as formatted text.
date-picker.useFor: Date Picker fits due dates, appointment dates and filters, where people would rather pick from a calendar than type. The trigger stays compact and the value is a native Date.

neighbours.name: date-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Field when people type the date or the value must show as read-only.

neighbours.name: date-range-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Range Picker when you need a start and an end date.

neighbours.name: date-time-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Time Picker when a time is part of the value.

neighbours.name: calendar
neighbours.guidance: Pick Calendar when the grid should stay visible.

rules: In a controlled picker, store `null` for no date. Don't use `undefined`.
Block days through `calendarProps.disabled` and validate the date again on the server.
`formatValue` changes only the trigger text, and it also replaces `placeholder`.
Set `name` to submit `YYYY-MM-DD` and `required` to block empty submits.
Date Picker has no read-only mode. Switch to Date Field for a locked date.

date-range-picker.summary: A typed start-and-end date field with a calendar popover, submitting two ISO day strings.
date-range-picker.useFor: Date Range Picker covers trips, out-of-office spans, report periods and bookings. People type both ends or select them in a calendar, and the control reports only complete ranges.

neighbours.name: calendar
neighbours.guidance: Pick Calendar with `selectionMode="range"` for an always-visible grid, two months side by side or quick shortcuts.

neighbours.name: date-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Picker when only one date is needed.

neighbours.name: date-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick two Date Fields only when the two ends are independent questions.

rules: Form data carries the two ends under `startName` and `endName`. The picker takes no single `name` and posts no combined range value.
Store `null` for an empty controlled range. The value is `{ from, to }`, and `undefined` means cleared.
Pass booking rules through `calendarProps` and re-check the range on the server.
Set `startLabel` and `endLabel` when the default Start Date and End Date names are too generic.
Use `iconMode="none"` when a separate Calendar on the page already drives the range.

date-time-picker.summary: One control for a local date and time, with typed segments, a calendar and a time selector.
date-time-picker.useFor: Date Time Picker fits scheduled publishes, meeting starts and reminders where both day and time matter. It submits a local date-time string with no time zone, so your app handles conversion.

neighbours.name: date-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Field when only the day matters.

neighbours.name: time-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Time Field for a time with no date, like a daily reminder.

neighbours.name: date-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Picker for a calendar-only date choice without typing.

rules: Treat the value as `{ date, time: { hour, minute } }` and store `null` when empty.
Set `name` to submit `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` and convert time zones yourself.
Use `minuteStep` for selector options. Validate the step and business hours in app code and on the server.
Set `hourCycle={12}` for AM/PM display; the value stays 24-hour.
Block days with `calendarProps.disabled`. The picker does not check time rules for you.

time-field.summary: An hour and minute input with typed segments and an optional selector, submitting 24-hour HH:mm.
time-field.useFor: Time Field takes times without a date: daily summaries, opening hours, reminder times, shift starts. It shows 12- or 24-hour time and supports a minute step in its selector.

neighbours.name: date-time-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Time Picker when the time belongs to a specific day.

neighbours.name: select
neighbours.guidance: Pick Select when only a few fixed time slots are allowed.

neighbours.name: date-field
neighbours.guidance: Pick Date Field when the value is a day rather than a time.

rules: Treat the value as `{ hour, minute }` in 24-hour time, even with `hourCycle={12}`.
Store `null` for an empty controlled value. `undefined` from `onValueChange` means cleared.
Set `name` to submit `HH:mm`, and `required` with FieldError for the missing message.
Use `minuteStep` for the selector. The field does not round typed minutes, so validate the step on the server.
Use `iconMode="decorative-start"` for compact start/end pairs, and do not pass a `locale` prop.

color-picker.summary: A trigger that opens a hex color editor with a saturation area, hue slider and RGB fields.
color-picker.useFor: Color Picker lets people choose any custom color, such as a brand or theme color. Placed as the last swatch of a palette, it ends a fixed set with a custom choice.

neighbours.name: color-swatch-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Color Swatch Picker when the choice is limited to a fixed palette.

neighbours.name: input
neighbours.guidance: Pick Input only if people paste hex values and never need to pick by eye.

rules: Expect lowercase hex strings from `onValueChange`; there is no alpha channel.
Keep an accessible name when hiding the value with `showValue={false}`.
Use `variant="swatch"` with `selected` to end a Color Swatch Picker row with a custom color.
`required` will not block submission, because the picker always holds a color.
Use `readOnly` to show a fixed color and `disabled` to remove it from the form.

color-swatch-picker.summary: A row of color or image swatches for choosing one option from a palette your app defines.
color-swatch-picker.useFor: Color Swatch Picker chooses from a fixed set: label colors, avatar backgrounds, theme presets or images. The value is the option key, so your data does not depend on the CSS color.

neighbours.name: color-picker
neighbours.guidance: Pick Color Picker when any color is allowed, or add it as the last swatch for a custom choice.

neighbours.name: radio-group
neighbours.guidance: Pick Radio Group when words describe the options better than color.

neighbours.name: select
neighbours.guidance: Pick Select when the palette is too large to show as swatches.

rules: Give each option a `label` and unique `value`. Screen readers announce the label.
Store the option key from `onValueChange` instead of the CSS color.
Use `indicator="ring"` for image swatches so the check does not cover the picture.
Place it in a Field with a `name` and `required` so FieldError can explain a missing choice.
Change swatch shape through the provider `radius` instead of custom classes.

editable.summary: Text that turns into its own field when clicked, for renaming a project, page or list item in place.
editable.useFor: Editable shows a value as plain text with a pencil beside it, and opens a field in the same spot to change it. Fit it to values people read often and rename now and then: a project title, a page name, a saved view in a list.

neighbours.name: input
neighbours.guidance: Pick Input for a value people fill in or change every visit, such as a settings form with one Save button.

neighbours.name: form
neighbours.guidance: Pick Form with open fields when several values change together and save as one.

neighbours.name: dialog
neighbours.guidance: Pick Dialog when a rename needs more than the name, such as a description and a visibility setting.

rules: Label it with a Field and FieldLabel, or give `EditableInput` an `aria-label`.
Set a `placeholder` for the empty state. Give `labels.edit` the item's name, such as "Rename project", so screen readers can tell pencils apart.
Save in `onValueCommit`. `onValueChange` also fires on every keystroke and on cancel.
In a list, set `activationMode="none"` so only the pencil opens the field and each row takes one tab stop.
When a value needs checking before it saves, wrap Editable in a Field and show the message with FieldError. A failing value keeps the field open.
Use `EditableTextarea` for text with line breaks; Cmd or Ctrl+Enter saves it.
